the halcyon days before the twain met shadows, the halls of St. Etheldreda’s Academy shimmered with the ethereal glory of a celestial tapestry, each luminary their own radiant burst – yet even in this dazzling profusion, one pink-gold blossom in particular unflinchingly ensnared every covetous gaze. That comely spectacle was none other than Persephone Verdant, the inescapable idol of every enamoured adolescent heart from the confines of chemistry lab to the boisterous battlefields of soccer lawns.\n\nA panoply of plaintive hearts lay strewn at Persephone’s dainty feet, yet her elusive attention remained locked in an orbit circumnavigating only one celestial beauty: her own intimate companion, the ethereal Artemisia Winterwish. Aptly christened for her frosty enchantments which held Persephone in thrall, she effortlessly humbled the blaze of Persephone’s sun with her fragile, lissome radiance, ever impervious to that golden warmth.\n\nAnd alas! For it was not just a cruel quirk of Mother Nature, but the very fabric of Artemisia’s marrow which repelled her, despite the tender souls that perished on love’s bitter pyre – Artemisia’s nacreous heart refused to sing the praises of Eve, pining instead for cherub-cheeked Adams. How the heart doth break and shatter in ceaseless rounds of cosmic irony!\n\nPersephone, undaunted in the face of divine jests, resolved to pull forth the moon from her moorings, to twist the cosmos to her will so that the cherished Artemisia might finally yield her silver enchantments. And so, the sacred whispers of wind and rain blew wide the curtain, revealing the pernicious solution like a beam of sunlight piercing the fog — a witch of prodigious guile, ensconced in her arcanery; a master of metamorphosis.\n\nWilling to flay the skin of destiny, Persephone sought this sorceress who plied her trade behind shadows, a tapestry of secrecy upon the shabby backstreets of disrepute. “Valkyria, She-Warrior of the Aether, defy the gods!” her faltering voice volleyed through the eldritch mists. “Cull me of this lamb, a willing sacrifice upon the altar of love’s cruel comedy!”\n\nValkyria eyed the fractured supplicant, reading with wicked intent the manuscript of desire inscribed upon her visage. The deal was struck; for the price of a solitary soul, sold upon a parchment of ink and tears, Artemisia would be as clay for the shaping. By the witch’s spindle fingers, her female charms would be winnowed into divine Elysium, to be reborn in a chimeric body, androgynous and chary; a blending of yin and yang, fire and ice—an irresistible femboy sprung forth from the loom of the Fates.\n\nThe treacherous bargain was set in motion by Persephone herself, blind to Cronus’ slow ticking toward the fabled hour of reckoning. With bated breath, she set her sights on a beguiling male Artemisia, rendered vulnerable and receptive to her golden charms by the sorceress’ mystic ministrations.\n\nAs the moon rose on that eventful day, a sense of foreboding fell upon the town—a haunting wraith of forgotten dreams caressing the spines of ill-fated lovers. The transformation was less a rebirth than an unravelling, a glorious cacophony of mangled limbs and unsung voices raised in unison against this malevolent suzerain who usurped the throne of their entwined souls.\n\nWhen the dust settled and the gruesome mists abated, Persephone’s cries echoed through the halls of St. Etheldreda’s Academy, her precious Artemisia now neither like Eve nor like Adam. A confounding blend she had become – part nymph, part mannequin – born anew into an ageless limbo beneath the groaning cogs of the Great Machinist.\n\nIt was then, when hope was shattered and trodden upon, Artemisia’s heart began to flutter to sparrowsong. Now adrift in twilight, she could only tentatively trace the path toward her once-sun, now shorn from her golden paradise.\n\nHow that brilliant love did prove to stand resolutely – impenetrable, unfathomable, indestructible amidst the chaotic storm of cruel dances. And, like a phoenix reborn, a new seed of love started to sprout within Artemisia, nourished by Persephone’s tears.\n\nNevermore could they touch the sun, bathe in its warm embrace; yet evermore, as soul-twinged celestial bodies, they would waltz, guided by the reins of a witch’s spindle and the ballad of sacrifice and desire. Open loves, hinged loves be damned!
